links.outcome: Reproducibility of answers across regenerated trials and effect of prompting on accuracy
links.effect: Passing mark averaged 75% across 3 trials with higher accuracy with prompts; considerable consistency in regenerating answers but often only partially correct responses.
links.quote: While demonstrating considerable consistency in regenerating answers, it often provided only partially correct responses.

links.outcome: Exam-based competency of ChatGPT on open-ended OHNS board questions
links.effect: ChatGPT achieved a passing mark (average 75% across 3 trials); concordance 92.06%; hallucinations and self-conflicting answers observed.
links.quote: In an open-ended question assessment, ChatGPT achieved a passing mark (an average of 75% across 3 trials) in the attempts and demonstrated higher accuracy with prompts.

unlisted_practices: Prompting (with vs without prompts) to improve LLM accuracy on open-ended exam questions

screen.reason: Evaluates ChatGPT's raw performance and safety/hallucinations on open-ended otolaryngology board exam questions using a proposed scoring framework, without testing a specific organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
